An independent depth-one calculation proves these sets already arise by one modality on a nonmodal formula and propositional closure; 6 nonmodal signatures establish sharpness. The singleton identities r=diamond top, box(a)=r→a and diamond(a)=min(r,a) are exact. The checker was executed against the actual public certificate and passed. No finite sampling is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: On the smallest fuzzy Kripke semantic carrier the familiar global noninterdefinability question has a finer answer: diamond alone can express box, but its 342 truth functions strictly exceed the 60 obtained using box alone. The complete one-variable equality-theory and sharp depth-one normalization expose the degree of expressive asymmetry and bound formula search on this natural base case. This is an intrinsic fragment algebra, not an arbitrary numerical slice; its exact hidden-parameter subalgebra count is not implied by the known size 342 of the ambient free Gödel algebra.
